name: modern-pedagogues-platform
description: The Modern Pedagogues website and platform

APP_URL.description: Public https URL, for example https://your-app.herokuapp.com (no trailing slash)

DATABASE_SSL_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED.description: Heroku Postgres uses a certificate chain Node cannot verify

SMTP_PASSWORD.description: A Google App Password (16 characters), never the account password

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Optional. Enables the Kaitlyn assistant (Google AI Studio key). Leave blank to keep Kaitlyn off.

ASSISTANT_DAILY_LIMIT.description: Maximum Kaitlyn replies per day across all visitors
